nodes.label:
Is a Venue
Confirmed?
nodes.title: Is a Venue Confirmed?
nodes.info: A confirmed venue means a specific room, day, and time -- not a vague 'maybe we could use the community room.'

nodes.label:
Secure a Venue
Agreement First
nodes.title: Secure a Venue Agreement First
nodes.info: Return to Chapter 4's venue agreement guidance before proceeding further.

nodes.label:
Is a Founding Team of
2+ People Assembled?
nodes.title: Is a Founding Team of 2+ People Assembled?
nodes.info: One person can start a club, but a founding team of two to four sharply reduces single leader dependency from day one.

nodes.label:
Recruit at Least One
Co-Founder Before Launch
nodes.title: Recruit at Least One Co-Founder Before Launch
nodes.info: Even a single committed co-founder splits the paperwork, background-check coordination, and first-session planning.

nodes.label:
Is a Background-Checked
Mentor Confirmed?
nodes.title: Is at Least One Background-Checked Mentor Confirmed?
nodes.info: A club cannot legally run its first session without at least one screened adult present, per Chapter 3.

nodes.label:
Complete Background Checks
Before Announcing a Date
nodes.title: Complete Background Checks Before Announcing a Date
nodes.info: Background checks can take one to three weeks to return -- start them early.

nodes.label:
Establish the Club and
Set a First Meeting Date
nodes.title: Establish the Club and Set a First Meeting Date
nodes.info: All four feasibility pillars are in place: evidence of interest, a venue, a team, and a screened mentor.
